review: Öufi Heathcliff is an ID that inflicts Tremor - Decay, which functions and interacts just like a normal Tremor. However, it additionally decreases the target Defense Level by 1 per 4 Tremor Potency, making it in theory a very great debuff. Now let us take a look at his Skills: - Skill 1 - Execution Advised - 2 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 11, Conditionals Met – 15. Inflicts Tremor Potency and Count. - Skill 2 - Final Warning - 2 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 16, Conditionals Met – 20. Inflicts Tremor Potency and Count. - Skill 3 - Execution Sentencing - 3 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 17, Conditionals Met – 23. On the third Coin, if the target’s Tremor Potency + Tremor Count ≥ 20, convert all Tremor to Tremor - Decay. Öufi Heathcliff clashes with other Tremor Conversion types, notably Reverb, making him sometimes risky to use. However, he is still worth running if you're able to trigger Tremor Entangleme
